diagnosis: Persistent leadership can retain strong winners, but the pre-2026 union ledger repeatedly spends stop proceeds on different weak correlated names. For example the lead252/exit60/two-position trial reaches63.21% peak drawdown by2024-01-30 despite14% per-position protection. hypothesis: Restrict new money and restoration, not existing intact units, until observable supplied-universe market health recovers. Protective sells are always allowed. Thus broad weakness cannot repeatedly fund weak replacements, while an intact strong technology holding is not sold merely because its peers are weak.

Admission requires three consecutive such observed closes. No external/reference/excluded security can supply the gate.

All other selected ownership rules and production execution remain unchanged.
